name: 218th Judicial District Court of Texas
region: Atascosa, Frio, La Salle and Wilson Counties, Texas
description: A rural district court serving four South Texas counties under one judge. Recordings are Zoom dockets held county by county, covering criminal, civil and family matters, with titles naming the county and docket.
sensitivity: Includes custody, protective-order and other family-law hearings about children.
Criminal defendants are named; dates of birth are sometimes stated.

name: Hidalgo County Court at Law No. 9
description: A county court at law on the Texas--Mexico border. Recordings are morning and afternoon civil and criminal Zoom dockets, mostly titled as the judge's personal Zoom room.
sensitivity: Defendants state personal phone numbers on the record, hundreds of times across the collection.
Criminal defendants are named.

name: Bexar County Court at Law No. 6
description: A statutory county court hearing misdemeanor criminal cases. Recordings are Zoom arraignment, pretrial, plea and probation-revocation dockets. The channel names no jurisdiction; Bexar County is inferred from the transcripts, which name it more than a thousand times.
sensitivity: Criminal defendants are named on screen and in speech.
Phone numbers are read aloud, mostly the probation office's but some personal.

name: Township of Montague Council
description: The council of a rural township in eastern Ontario. Recordings are Council and Committee of the Whole meetings, special meetings and the Recreation and Culture Committee.
sensitivity: Street addresses are read out.

name: Austin County Court at Law
description: A rural county court at law west of Houston. Recordings are morning and afternoon Zoom dockets and individual hearings, some titled with cause numbers and party surnames.
sensitivity: Titles and speech name criminal defendants; phone numbers are sometimes read aloud.

name: Temple Municipal Court
description: The municipal court of the City of Temple, which hears Class C misdemeanors and city-ordinance cases. Recordings are Zoom court-appearance sessions for defendants.
sensitivity: Defendants are named; dates of birth and phone numbers are stated.

name: City of Lakewood Council and commissions
description: A Pierce County city near Tacoma. Recordings are virtual City Council meetings, with the Arts Commission, Planning Commission and Public Safety Advisory Committee.
sensitivity: Phone numbers and street addresses are occasionally read out.

name: City of Sault Ste. Marie City Council and boards
description: The council of a northern Ontario city, with its boards and committees: Tourism, Environmental Sustainability, Historic Sites, Cultural Vitality and the Committee of Adjustment. Tiles carry role-prefixed names such as a councillor's title and surname.
sensitivity: Street addresses are frequently read out.

name: Florida Fifth District Court of Appeal
description: An intermediate appellate court of Florida, then seated in Daytona Beach. Recordings are Zoom oral arguments before three-judge panels.
sensitivity: Arguments name private litigants.

name: Ohio First District Court of Appeals
description: The intermediate appellate court for Hamilton County. Recordings are oral arguments before three-judge panels across criminal, civil, juvenile and family appeals.
sensitivity: Arguments discuss child-abuse, juvenile-delinquency and guardianship matters.

name: City of Norman City Council
description: The council of Oklahoma's third-largest city. Recordings are conference and regular meetings, study sessions, special sessions and the Council Oversight Committee. The channel alternates between gallery view and a screen-share layout, so only video-verified meetings are listed.

name: Waipā District Council
type: District council, committees and community boards
description: A district council in the Waikato region. Recordings span full council, standing committees (Finance and Corporate, Strategic Planning and Policy, Audit and Risk), the Cambridge and Te Awamutu community boards, ward committees and the Iwi Consultative Committee. Released with prior work and used to calibrate the active-speaker detector.
sensitivity: Iwi Consultative Committee recordings involve Māori representatives; Māori data sovereignty considerations apply.

name: Justice of the Peace Court, Precinct 1
description: A Texas justice court hearing small claims, evictions, Class C misdemeanors, bond settings and driver's-license hearings. Many recordings are titled with the case number alone.
sensitivity: Individual cases are identified by case number in titles; defendants and eviction parties are named.

name: Town of Lewisboro Town Board and Planning Board
description: A town in northern Westchester County. Recordings are Town Board and Planning Board meetings and the Comprehensive Plan steering committee, posted by Lewisboro TV.
sensitivity: Street addresses are frequently read out.

name: City of Beaumont Council
description: Regular and special council meetings and Committee of the Whole for a city near Edmonton. Councillors carry role-and-name labels.

name: Supreme Court of Guam
description: The court of last resort for the U.S. territory of Guam. Recordings are virtual oral arguments in civil and criminal appeals and virtual status and disqualification hearings, titled with case captions and docket numbers.
sensitivity: Captions name private litigants; dates of birth are occasionally stated.

name: Chambers County Probate Court and Commissioners Court
description: Chambers County's official channel, which carries the county judge's probate dockets and the Commissioners Court's regular and special meetings. The two are pooled because they share a channel, a presiding county judge and one Zoom setup.
sensitivity: Probate dockets concern private estates and guardianships.

name: Albemarle County School Board
description: The school board of a county surrounding Charlottesville. Recordings are board meetings and budget work sessions. Released with prior work.
sensitivity: School boards may seat student representatives, who may be minors; public comment can concern named children.

name: Eighth Court of Appeals of Texas
description: The intermediate appellate court for far West Texas. Recordings are oral arguments and a small number of swearing-in ceremonies; most uploads carry Zoom's default title "My Meeting", so titles identify few cases.
sensitivity: Arguments name private litigants.

name: City of West Miami City Commission
description: The commission of a small city in Miami-Dade County. Recordings are regular and special City Commission meetings and Planning and Zoning meetings, first fully virtual and later hybrid.

name: Hunter's Hill Council
description: Council meetings of a Sydney local government area, uploaded in several parts per meeting.

name: Town of Kensington Town Council
description: The council of a small town in Montgomery County, Maryland. Council meetings posted in gallery view by Montgomery Municipal Cable, the county's public-access channel, rather than by the town itself.
sensitivity: Street addresses are read out.

name: Town of Pittsfield Town Council and boards
description: Town Council, Planning Board, Parks and Recreation Committee and Ordinance Committee meetings of a small central Maine town.

name: City of Madison Heights City Council
description: Regular and special City Council meetings of a Detroit-area city, posted by the city's cable channel MHTV.

name: District of Columbia Court of Appeals
description: The highest court of the District of Columbia. Recordings are Zoom oral arguments before panels of judges. Released with prior work and used to calibrate the active-speaker detector.
sensitivity: Arguments name private litigants.

name: Town of Pine Plains Town Board
description: Town Board meetings and workshop meetings, including a zoning-review workshop, of a Dutchess County town.
sensitivity: The attorney--client session may contain privileged discussion posted publicly.

name: Fifth Court of Appeals of Texas
description: Dallas's intermediate appellate court during the first months of remote proceedings. Each recording is one civil or criminal oral argument, titled with its docket number and case caption.
sensitivity: Captions name private litigants; at least one family-law appeal is captioned with the parties' initials, the convention Texas uses to protect children.

name: Seventh Court of Appeals of Texas
description: The intermediate appellate court for the Texas Panhandle. Recordings are oral arguments in civil and criminal appeals, plus pretrial conferences of special courts of review convened at the court.
sensitivity: Case captions name private litigants.

name: Town of Westfield Town Council
description: Town Council regular, conference and reorganization meetings of a Union County town.

name: District of Lantzville Council
description: Regular and special council meetings of a small Vancouver Island municipality.

name: Town of Pompey Town Board and boards
description: Town Board, Zoning Board of Appeals and Environmental Conservation Commission meetings of an Onondaga County town.
sensitivity: Applicants speak in Zoning Board of Appeals hearings.

name: Tecumseh Public Schools Board of Education
description: Board of Education meetings and a budget workshop of a small southeast Michigan district.
sensitivity: School boards may seat student representatives, who may be minors.

name: City of Reynoldsburg council and commissions
description: City Council, Planning Commission, Community Commission and Civilian Review Board meetings of a Columbus-area city.

name: First Court of Appeals of Texas
description: One of the two intermediate appellate courts seated in Houston, hearing civil and criminal appeals. The recordings are Zoom oral arguments before panels of justices, with appellate counsel for each side.
sensitivity: Case captions name private litigants.

name: City of Palo Alto boards and commissions
description: Palo Alto's appointed bodies, pooled from the city channel: the Planning and Transportation, Human Relations and Utilities Advisory commissions, the Policy and Services Committee, and City Council interviews of commission applicants.
sensitivity: Commission-applicant interviews feature members of the public.

name: Manningham City Council
description: Council meetings of a municipality in Melbourne's eastern suburbs.

name: City of Charlottesville council, boards and commissions
description: Bodies pooled from the city's communications channel: City Council work sessions (including one with the Police Civilian Review Board), the Planning Commission, the Board of Architectural Review, and one Charlottesville City Schools board meeting.
sensitivity: The channel also carries a Youth Council; none of its meetings are in this collection.

name: Town of Bruderheim Council
description: Regular and special council meetings of a small Alberta town, often uploaded in parts.
sensitivity: Members of the public, such as a local business representative, appear as participants.

name: Beverly School Committee
description: Remote meetings of the Beverly School Committee, its Committee of the Whole and its Curriculum, Instruction and Student Life subcommittee, posted by the city's public-access channel.
sensitivity: School boards may seat student representatives, who may be minors.

name: Town of Kentville Council and committees
description: Council meetings and Council Advisory Committee meetings of an Annapolis Valley town.

name: Tenth Court of Appeals of Texas
description: The intermediate appellate court seated in Waco. Seven long sessions of virtual oral arguments, several held in conjunction with Blinn College and Sam Houston State University.
sensitivity: Arguments name private litigants.

name: St. Louis Public Schools Board of Education
description: The board of education of the St. Louis district during the four months of 2020 in which it met in gallery view.
sensitivity: School boards may seat student representatives, who may be minors.

name: City of Jersey Village City Council
description: Regular, special and budget meetings of a small Houston-area city, including a joint session with its fire-control and crime-control district boards.

name: City of Renton City Council
description: City Council meetings and Committee of the Whole sessions of a city south of Seattle.

name: Alexandria City Public Schools School Board
description: School Board meetings and work sessions, the Budget Advisory Committee and an equity-and-access event of a Northern Virginia school division.
sensitivity: School boards may seat student representatives, who may be minors.

name: City of Seaside Homelessness Think Tank
description: A working group on homelessness, posted by the City of Seaside, bringing together officials, service providers and residents of a coastal Oregon city.
sensitivity: Discussion concerns people experiencing homelessness, who may be identifiable and may participate.

name: Bath Charter Township boards
description: The Senior Services Advisory Board, Zoning Board of Appeals and Planning Commission of a township near Lansing.
sensitivity: Applicants speak in Zoning Board of Appeals hearings.

name: City of Greater Geelong Council
description: Ordinary, special and community-focus council meetings and planning committee meetings of Victoria's second-largest city.

name: Hidalgo County Court at Law No. 5
description: A county court at law in Hidalgo County. Three long arraignment and docket sessions held on consecutive days.
sensitivity: Criminal defendants are named; personal phone numbers are stated.

name: Fourteenth Court of Appeals of Texas
description: Houston's second intermediate appellate court, which shares its district with the First Court. Five Zoom oral arguments before panels of justices.
sensitivity: Case captions name private litigants.

name: City of Malibu City Council and Planning Commission
description: Regular and special meetings of Malibu's City Council and Planning Commission. Tiles carry role banners with full names, which gives this collection some of the most reliably attributable speaker labels.
sensitivity: Members of the public speak in planning hearings.
